title: How do I talk to my neighbors in the elevator?
L: (1) Kim: I moved into a new apartment last week, and I feel awkward in the elevator with my neighbors.
We just stand there in silence. What do you usually say to people you hardly know?
(2) Omar: Keep it simple! A smile and a quick “Good morning” is enough.
Talking about the weather works well, like “Nice weather today, isn't it?”
Just don't ask personal questions, like how much someone earns or why they're single.
(3) Rosa: Learn their names as soon as you can. People love it when you remember them.
After a few weeks, you could invite a neighbor over for coffee on a weekend.
Trust me, a little small talk makes a big difference, and soon the elevator won't feel so awkward!

exq.a: She does not know what to say to her neighbors in the elevator.
w: She does not like her new apartment.

exq.why: “A smile and a quick ‘Good morning’ is enough.”

exq.q: What does Omar say not to ask about?
exq.why: “don’t ask personal questions, like how much someone earns”.

exq.q: What does Rosa say people love?
exq.why: “People love it when you remember them.”

exq.q: When could Kim invite a neighbor for coffee?
exq.why: “After a few weeks, you could invite a neighbor over”.
